economic_ownership_map.label: Wheeler River ISR project (Phoenix/Gryphon)
economic_ownership_map.ownership_claim: Probability-weighted NPV of Wheeler River in-situ recovery development
economic_ownership_map.evidence: Referenced in 40-F reclamation and AIF (Exhibit 99.1); wide range pending AIF NPV proof

probability_and_timing.timing_basis: FID window 2028-2032 per company public framing; production first pounds 2030+ if permitted; assessed over seven-year equity horizon.
probability_and_timing.probability_basis: Base 45% FID probability reflects pre-licensing status and historical Athabasca ISR timelines; low 15% / high 65% bracket permit and funding risk.
probability_and_timing.remaining_capital_basis: Remaining construction capital not proof-complete without AIF; base embeds partial risk in range not a separate capex line until feasibility indexed.

economic_ownership_map.tax_and_realization_adjustments: Low zero until AIF NPV proof; base/high bracket [Assumption] until Exhibit 99.1 indexed
economic_ownership_map.falsifier: The next decision milestone fails, remaining capital rises materially, or the stated success probability no longer fits observable progress.

probability_and_timing.timing_basis: JV mill tolling and exploration options monetize only if Wheeler River or partner projects advance; seven-year horizon.
probability_and_timing.probability_basis: Base 25% realization probability for non-core exploration/JV upside; low 5% / high 40% until AIF segment disclosure indexed.
probability_and_timing.remaining_capital_basis: Exploration spend largely expensed; remaining capital for JV calls embedded in wide range pending AIF.
